question: How many recall records does Stryker have for uncemented knees (MBH) across all years?
answer:
Stryker has **26 recall records** for MBH (uncemented knee) across all years, grouped into **14 recall events**. The tool returned only the first 10 records, so I haven't reviewed the rest.

- The most recent shown is Z-3203-2026 (started 2026-07-30), which covers UHMWPE polyethylene aged over five years and a possible increase in wear [Z-3203-2026].
- Z-2461-2026 and Z-2462-2026 (started 2026-05-19) describe Triathlon Universal Baseplate size 3 and 4 units in each other's packaging [Z-2461-2026] [Z-2462-2026].
- Z-1259-2024 through Z-1265-2024 (started 2024-02-06) cite potential packaging breaches of the inner and outer sterile blisters [Z-1259-2024].

Recall records are not a measure of how many devices were affected or of how dangerous they were. A count of recalls also doesn't show whether Stryker is more or less safe than other manufacturers.
